title: Column chromatography
caption: A mixture of a non-polar hydrocarbon and a polar alcohol is loaded on top of a silica column and washed through with a non-polar eluent. The hydrocarbon barely sticks to the silica and comes off first; the alcohol hydrogen-bonds to the silica and comes off later.
alt: A silica column with two separating bands: the non-polar compound lower down, the polar compound near the top.
description: Lower band: the non-polar compound, eluting first.
Upper band: the polar alcohol, held back by the silica.
